name: aleph-w
description: Header-dominant C++20 library of data structures, algorithms and a cellular-automata framework.

gsl.description: Link GSL and pass it to the consumers (ALEPH_WITH_GSL), for the code that uses GSL through Aleph-w. A default feature until 8.0.0, as ALEPH_WITH_GSL is ON.

x11.description: Build the X11 live viewer (ca-x11-viewer.H); requires system libX11.
